from PIL import Image
import numpy as np, math
im=np.array(Image.open('observations/obs_0100.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)

brown=(R>70)&(R<175)&(G>25)&(G<100)&(B<80)&(R-B>40)&(R-G>25)
pot=(R>120)&(R-G>55)&(G-B>5)&(G<95)   # terracotta pot
print('--- brown table cols (vtop,vbot) ---')
for u in range(0,180,8):
    c=np.nonzero(brown[:,u])[0]
    if len(c): print(u,c.min(),c.max())
print('--- pot ---')
ys,xs=np.nonzero(pot); print('pot u',xs.min(),xs.max(),'v',ys.min(),ys.max())
" 2>/dev/null
